label: Remix Voice
description: Generate voice previews from a voice you already have, changed the way you describe (another accent, a higher pitch, a slower pace). Each preview carries its audio and a preview id; wire the one you like into Create Voice to mint it as a new voice. The voice you started from stays as it is.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (the voice you remix comes from it, and remixed voices live in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: voice
inputs.label: Voice
inputs.placeholder: Pick a voice, or paste a voice id
inputs.description: The voice to start from. ElevenLabs remixes voices that were designed or cloned, and Voice Library voices with an infinite notice period.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: What to change about the voice (its gender, accent, speaking style, pace or audio quality), in 5 to 1000 characters.
inputs.placeholder: Use a higher pitch and change to a Boston accent.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The line the previews speak, 100 to 1000 characters. Leave empty and ElevenLabs writes a line that suits the description; the `text` output carries the line either way.

inputs.name: outputFormat
inputs.label: Output format
inputs.description: The format of the previews' audio. opus_48000_* is stored as Ogg Opus. ElevenLabs gives mp3_44100_192 only on its Creator plan and above, and pcm_44100 only on Pro and above.

inputs.name: guidanceScale
inputs.label: Guidance scale
inputs.description: How closely the voice follows the description: lower leaves ElevenLabs more freedom, higher sticks to the description and can sound artificial or robotic. ElevenLabs recommends a longer, more detailed description at a lower value. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 2.

inputs.name: loudness
inputs.description: How loud the previews are, from -1 (quietest) to 1 (loudest); 0 is roughly -24 LUFS. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 0.5.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: If you want the same voice again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same settings: ElevenLabs says the same seed with the same inputs gives the same voice. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

inputs.name: promptStrength
inputs.label: Prompt strength
inputs.description: How far the previews move from the original voice, from 0 to 1: low keeps most of what makes it recognizable, high follows the description and can change the voice entirely. Leave empty to let ElevenLabs decide.

outputs.name: previews
outputs.description: The generated previews, each with its audio and the `voiceId` Create Voice takes.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The line the previews speak: your `text`, or the one ElevenLabs wrote when it was empty.

then.message: ElevenLabsRemixVoice '{id}' has an empty `voice`: pick the voice to remix, or paste its id.
ElevenLabsRemixVoice '{id}' has a `description` under 5 characters, and ElevenLabs takes 5 to 1000: say what to change in more detail.
ElevenLabsRemixVoice '{id}' has a `description` over 1000 characters, and ElevenLabs takes 5 to 1000: shorten it.
ElevenLabsRemixVoice '{id}' has a `text` under 100 characters, and ElevenLabs speaks a line of 100 to 1000: write a longer line, or leave `text` empty and ElevenLabs writes one.
ElevenLabsRemixVoice '{id}' has a `text` over 1000 characters, and ElevenLabs speaks a line of 100 to 1000: shorten it, or leave `text` empty and ElevenLabs writes one.
